title: Trouble No. 3    Shift point too high or too low

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for shift point diagnosis starting with output diagnostic code check, then voltage checks at DG terminal, ECT ECU terminals, and pattern select switch
labels: Connect a voltmeter to the DG terminal and body. Does DG terminal voltage vary with changes in throttle opening?
Is voltage between ECT ECU terminals BR and GND as follows? 0V: Brake pedal released 12V: Brake pedal depressed
Computer power source and earth faulty
DG terminal wire open or short
Check voltage between ECT ECU terminals PWR and GND. Power Pattern: 12V Normal Pattern: 1V
OK - Faulty ECT ECU Faulty transmission
No - Faulty pattern select switch system
Diagnosis code - Proceed to trouble No. 1 (AT-12)
